description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories, with six distinct slices shown. The categories are labeled as "chat" (red, 41.2%), "math" (blue, 21.9%), "tooluse" (green, 11.6%), "multi turn chat" (orange, 9.3%), "code" (purple, 9.0%), and "instruction follow" (pink, 6.9%). The chart includes a legend that corresponds to the colors used for each category, and percentage labels are displayed outside the slices. The slices are arranged in descending order of their proportions, with "chat" being the largest and "instruction follow" being the smallest.
